Tergooi MC
Department of Radiology
Date: 12 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of known prostate cancer. PSA 6.9 ng/mL.

FINDINGS:
The prostate measures 57.11 mL in volume. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of low signal intensity in the transition zone, mid right peripheral gland. This lesion measures approximately 12 mm in its greatest dimension. On diffusion-weighted imaging, the area shows restricted diffusion with corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences demonstrate early and intense enhancement of the same region. No extraprostatic extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or bone marrow replacement is seen.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the transition zone, mid right.
Prostate volume: 57.11 mL.
PSA density: 0.121 ng/mL/mL.

previous_notes.text: 23 May 2024 - Dr. E. Mulder (GP): Patient presented for routine follow-up. PSA measured at 1.7 ng/mL, which was stable compared to previous values. Discussed the recent biopsy results showing ISUP grade group 2 prostate cancer. Patient was advised to continue with scheduled urological follow-up and was reassured regarding the current low-risk features. No new symptoms were reported.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1:
Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals acinar adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns were identified. Perineural invasion is absent. The tumour is located in the transition zone, mid right.

Summary:
The histological trajectory across the available timepoints remains stable with no grade progression noted.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
